finalText:
**Big but mostly mechanical.** `account_id` hits 1082 times in 94 files. About 1027 of those are internal service code. Safe to rename.

Four zones must not be renamed.

| Zone | Files | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 1 | Public contract. Fields marked frozen. |
| `lib/serialize.js` WIRE values | 1 | Right side is the public wire name. |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 12 | Already applied. Editing breaks the down step. |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | 4 | `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites edits. |

Next: get the platform team to confirm they will use a new migration, not edits.
